roslib.min.js in this directory is roslibjs 1.4.1, unmodified:
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/roslib@1.4.1/build/roslib.min.js
  sha256 3c510df2bc04be9d5b07efafb01eb5f473d8a5092d93292351a715ca60daf9d6
It is bundled with the dashboard (web/index.html) so that the live mode needs no internet (the
test stand has none, docs/organizers/answers.md §7). Its licence, from the npm package:
